signals.summary: Atlassian cut about 1,600 roles (10%), including 900-plus in software R&D, restructuring to invest in AI.
CTO Rajeev Rajan stepped down at end of March, replaced jointly by Taroon Mandhana and Vikram Rao.
Quarterly revenue of US$1.6bn, up US$300m year on year, alongside a net loss of US$42m; company remains unprofitable.
Revenue grew 23% year on year to $1.6bn; crossed $6bn ARR, 350,000 customers and 5 million Rovo monthly users.
Non-GAAP operating income of $430.2m in fiscal Q2, up 28% year on year, though GAAP operating loss was $47.7m.
